description: This file defines a controller class 'Security' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Common' namespace. It handles security-related functionalities such as viewing security details, listing security items, getting a specific list, installation, and storage management for an OpenCart administrative interface.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Controller class managing security features such as listing security info, installing, and managing storage paths, in an OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the security page view with list and user token data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a security list, including directory existence checks and sessions data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a string representing the current security status, including checks for installation directory, storage directory, admin directory, permissions, and security of paths.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation tasks: validates permission, checks and deletes existing install dirs, moves files, and updates configuration files accordingly.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Manages storage directory settings, including validation, directory creation, and moving files, with pagination.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Manages storage directory settings, including validation, directory creation, and moving files, with pagination.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified security paths and directories after permission validation.
